title: My Week
text:
Today is Monday. I go to school on Monday. On Tuesday I have English class. My favorite day is Friday because I play football with my friends.

On Saturday I go to the park with my family. We have lunch outside. On Sunday I stay at home and read books. Sunday is my day to rest.

questions.text: What day does the writer have English class?
Where does the writer go on Saturday?
Why is Friday probably the writer's favorite day?
options: It is the first day of the week
The writer plays football with friends

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel on Sunday?

vocabulary.definition: the one you like more than all the others
a sport played with a ball by two teams of eleven players
in the open air, not inside a building
to relax and do nothing tiring

paragraph_translations: Сьогодні понеділок. Я ходжу до школи в понеділок. У вівторок у мене урок англійської. Мій улюблений день — п'ятниця, тому що я граю у футбол з друзями.
У суботу я ходжу з родиною до парку. Ми обідаємо надворі. У неділю я залишаюся вдома і читаю книжки. Неділя — мій день для відпочинку.
